g.text: Ask ChatGPT to design a form
ChatGPT opens its internal WebMCP tab
Agent reads and edits with WebMCP tools
create_live_handoff mints a fresh link (start_pairing mints one too)
Open the link in another browser
Is the token valid and unused?
Join the live session and remove the token from the URL
Does the new browser expose WebMCP?
Open a safe, independent design copy
Ask ChatGPT for a fresh live link
